signature.name: VTask.comp
signature.type: {k : Type u_1} -> {V1 : Type u_2} -> {P1 : Type u_3} -> {V2 : Type u_4} -> {P2 : Type u_5} -> {V3 : Type u_6} -> {P3 : Type u_7} -> [Ring k] -> [AddCommGroup V1] -> [Module k V1] -> [AddTorsor V1 P1] -> [AddCommGroup V2] -> [Module k V2] -> [AddTorsor V2 P2] -> [AddCommGroup V3] -> [Module k V3] -> [AddTorsor V3 P3] -> (f : P2 →ᵃ[k] P3) -> (g : P1 →ᵃ[k] P2) -> P1 →ᵃ[k] P3

conventions.statement: VTask.comp f g applies g first and f second, matching the standard mathematical convention for composition (right-to-left), consistent with LinearMap.comp and Function.comp.
conventions.note: This means the second argument g is the 'inner' map and the first argument f is the 'outer' map.
